title: Eightco's $90M OpenAI Bet Brings Tom Lee To Board But Stock Can't Break $1 - Eightco Holdings (NASDAQ:ORBS)
summary: Eightco, a significant holder of OpenAI tokens and a major investor in AI and blockchain companies, faces a severe market downturn with its stock losing 98% of its value and trading within a tight range.
sentiment_reason: The article describes a sharp stock price decline and extremely low volatility, indicating a strong negative market impact.
